messages:
sasha: Morning async — quick standup

I did: onboarded synthia-v3-smallQ to staging, ran baseline evals, fixed a tokenizer mismatch in promptset-14.
Blockers: CI evals flaky for long-context tests (timeouts in `eval_runner`), seeing occasional <EOS> truncation. Need someone to eyeball batching change.
Today: opening PR with fix + will run a full Spanish promptset sweep after lunch. ping @omar @jia for QA.

omar: Taking a look at PR #5342 now. Saw similar flakiness yesterday — likely kv-cache alignment after packing change.

jia: I can pair at 1pm PT. Re: timeout, what's the failing command? paste logs?

sasha: failing command: `pytest tests/evals/long_context.py::TestLongContext::test_generation_timeout -q` Log snippet:
```
E   TimeoutError: generation exceeded 10s
  File "infra/serve/generator.py", line 342, in generate
```

luke: quick thought — try lowering batch size when running the long-context smoke tests, e.g., `BATCH=1` in the test harness. I pushed a small change to `eval-harness` that might help.

jen: taking the Spanish promptset sweep after lunch. Also can review #5342 after @omar gives initial pass.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Staging model group `synthia-v3-smallq` deployed to east-1 with version v2026.03.17-118

omar: ack, will review now. If I can't reproduce locally, we'll schedule a short pairing.

sasha: thanks — if someone can leave a quick review or minor LGTM, I can merge and kick off the nightly regressions. also, @luke can you drop the test command to try with `BATCH=1`? :pray:

luke: done — re-ran locally with `BATCH=1` and it passed. pushed results to thread: https://ci.redwood.ai/1234/overview

sasha: sweet. will merge after @omar. tagging this as 'needs-cr' and 'gate' on the eval dashboard.

jen: noted. no blockers from infra side.

jia: 1pm PT ready to pair. also adding a short note to the promptset doc about tokenizer edgecases.

sasha: awesome — thanks team :rocket:
